# Teewald

> Teewald is a free third-person survival horror game with a PlayStation 1 look that runs right in the web browser (PC, phone and tablet). It is set in Teewald, a fictional small town of German settlers in the hills of southern Brazil, inspired by Santa Maria do Herval (Rio Grande do Sul). In May 1997, deep in autumn and fog, livestock turns up dead with two holes in the neck and not a drop of blood, and a stranger decides to stay and find out what walks in the woods.

- Play: https://fabianokunst.github.io/Teewald-3d/?lang=en (free, nothing to install, no account needed)
- Official site: https://fabianokunst.github.io/Teewald-3d/site/en/
- Creator: Fabiano Kunst (indie game)
- Genre: survival horror / third-person horror, single player, twelve chapters, each built around a legend from the Brazilian countryside
- Gameplay: over-the-shoulder camera, scarce ammo, punches and melee weapons that wear out and break, 9 mm pistol, dodge, 16-slot inventory, documents to read (FILES), conversations with 24 townsfolk, three difficulty levels and an S-to-C rank for each chapter
- Visuals: CLEAN 3D (default) or RETRO PS1 (320×240, dithering and 15-bit color); weather with late afternoon, night, fog, rain and storms; all sound generated in code
- Platforms: any up-to-date browser with WebGL (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari) on PC, phone and tablet
- Controls: keyboard and mouse, controller (USB or Bluetooth, with aim assist and vibration) or touch screen
- Languages: Portuguese, English, Spanish and German
- Progress: saved automatically in the browser itself
- Setting: streets, river and terrain from open data (OpenStreetMap, Microsoft Global ML Building Footprints and SRTM), with about 600 buildings on their real footprints
- Technology: Three.js (WebGL) and Vite

A work of fiction: Teewald was born of imagination. The characters, their names, the dialogue and everything that happens in the game are made up, and any resemblance to real persons, living or dead, or to real events is purely coincidental. Santa Maria do Herval (RS) served only as inspiration for the setting: the street layout and street names, the river, the terrain and a few places come from public maps and appear only as scenery. The game does not portray the town, its residents, businesses or institutions, and has no connection whatsoever with the City Hall or any organization in the municipality.

No spoilers: the site only tells what the player hears and reads right after arriving in town. The creatures of each chapter and what happens after the first night are left for the game.

---

# Teewald — survival horror with a PS1 look

> Third-person survival horror with a PlayStation 1 look, set in a small town of German settlers in the hills of southern Brazil. Free, in your browser.

Page: https://fabianokunst.github.io/Teewald-3d/site/en/  
Play free in your browser: https://fabianokunst.github.io/Teewald-3d/?lang=en

*Vale do Herval · Rio Grande do Sul · maio de 1997*

## Teewald

Something walks in the woods.

A third-person survival horror game with a PlayStation 1 look, set in a small town of German settlers in the hills of southern Brazil. The fog won’t lift, livestock turns up drained in the pasture, and nobody leaves the house after dark. Except you.

[Play now](https://fabianokunst.github.io/Teewald-3d/?lang=en) [Read the story](https://fabianokunst.github.io/Teewald-3d/site/en/historia.html)

Free · in your browser · nothing to install

**Headlines from the Folha de Teewald:** Dead sheep on Linha Schmitt · City Hall: “it’s a pampas fox” · Kartoffelfest canceled · Shops close at 6 p.m. · Missing: gray cat, answers to Mimi · Lost: black dog with a red collar · Bus to Novo Hamburgo never came · Brigada Militar asks that no one go into the woods armed at night.

*Poster in the square*

### Wanted

Over the last few nights, chickens, ducks and even sheep have turned up dead in Teewald. All with two holes in the neck and not a drop of blood left.

City Hall says it’s a pampas fox. The veterinary office says dogs. The reporter who came up from Porto Alegre has already counted eleven cases in ten days, and nobody will talk to her.

You’re not from here. You arrived on a foggy afternoon, along the Rio Cadeia promenade, and decided to stay and find out what walks in the woods. The town doesn’t like questions, but every resident knows a piece of the story.

> When I turned on my flashlight, its eyes shone red. Then it was gone into the woods, leaping.
>
> — Seu Arno, fisherman on the promenade

![Wanted poster with the silhouette of a hunched creature with red eyes](https://fabianokunst.github.io/Teewald-3d/site/img/documentos/en/cartaz-chupacabras.png)
*Pinned to the bulletin board in Praça 10 de Abril, beside the end of the promenade.*

*What awaits you*

### Old-school horror

An over-the-shoulder camera, scarce ammo and a whole town to cross in the dark. The way horror games were in the ’90s, only in your browser.

*RETRO PS1 · 320×240*

#### The PlayStation 1 look

Hard-edged polygons, pixel-art textures and characters built like in the first 3D games. Play in CLEAN 3D or RETRO PS1, with real dithering and 15-bit color.

*Real map*

#### A town that exists

Streets, river, square and hills from real maps, with about 600 buildings on their true footprints.

#### Classic survival horror

An inventory that pauses the game, melee weapons that wear out and break, rocks to throw, and cuca (crumb cake) with marcela tea to patch yourself up.

#### Backcountry legends

Twelve chapters, each with a story the old folks only tell in a whisper, by the wood stove. Which is which, you’ll find out inside.

#### Fog, rain and thunder

Your flashlight reaches only a few yards, and sound comes from every side.

#### Plays anywhere

On PC, phone or tablet, with keyboard and mouse, controller or touch. Your progress saves itself in the browser.

**Where and how to play:** PC, Phone, Tablet, Controller, Touch, Português, English, Español, Deutsch.

> Herval comes from erva-mate. Teewald, in Hunsrik: the tea woods. Pretty, isn’t it? But the old folks had a different respect for these woods. Nobody went in there after sundown.
>
> — Professor Edgar, who knows the colonists’ diaries

# The story — Teewald

> Teewald, o mato do chá: uma colônia de imigrantes do Hunsrück no Vale do Herval. Maio de 1997, neblina, e a criação aparecendo morta sem uma gota de sangue.

Page: https://fabianokunst.github.io/Teewald-3d/site/en/historia.html  
Play free in your browser: https://fabianokunst.github.io/Teewald-3d/?lang=en

*The story*

## The tea woods

Teewald is a small town of German settlers in the Herval Valley, in the hills of southern Brazil. It has a church with a tall tower, a shoe factory, a potato festival, and woods the old folks never entered after sundown.

*The colony*

### The ones who cut the trails

The first colonists came from the Hunsrück in the 19th century and cut trails through the araucaria woods. They named the place after what they found there: *Teewald*, the tea woods, for the erva-mate. In Portuguese, it became Herval.

To this day people speak Hunsrik in the kitchen, sip chimarrão on the benches in the square and eat cuca (crumb cake) at the colonial afternoon coffee. The parish church looks down on the town, the shoe factory changes shifts at night and, every autumn, Rua Beno Closs turns into the Kartoffelfest pavilion.

The old folks respected those woods. In their diaries there’s a word nobody likes to repeat: *Blutsauger*. The bloodsucker.

![The parish church in the late afternoon, in the fog](https://fabianokunst.github.io/Teewald-3d/site/img/capturas/igreja.jpg)
*The parish church seen from the square*

*Maio de 1997*

### The last few weeks

It started far off, out in the countryside. Then it crept closer to the houses.

Everything here you’ll hear from the townsfolk or read in the town’s papers as soon as you arrive. The rest, the game will tell.

1. **May 3:** The Folha de Teewald reports seven sheep dead on Linha Schmitt. No large wounds, just two holes in the neck. Drained dry.
2. **That same week:** Chickens, ducks, a young goat, a cat gone stiff behind the shed. Dona Erna loses all twelve of her hens in a single night.
3. **Sunday night:** Bóris, Lucas’s dog, breaks his chain barking at the woods. Then he stops barking. All at once.
4. **Monday night:** Mimi, Dona Hilda’s cat, goes out and doesn’t come back. She’s never stayed out all night.
5. **Notice No. 41:** City Hall cancels the Kartoffelfest and orders the shops to close at six. Officially, it’s a pampas fox.
6. **Today:** You arrive on a foggy autumn afternoon, along the Rio Cadeia promenade. There’s a new poster on the bulletin board in the square.

*From the town files*

### Pinned-up papers

Around town there are newspaper clippings, posters, letters and diary pages. In the game, every paper you read is kept in FILES. These are on the bulletin board.

![Clipping from the Folha de Teewald: dead sheep on Linha Schmitt](https://fabianokunst.github.io/Teewald-3d/site/img/documentos/en/jornal.png)
*Folha de Teewald, 3 de maio de 1997*

![City Hall notice canceling the Kartoffelfest](https://fabianokunst.github.io/Teewald-3d/site/img/documentos/en/oficio.png)
*City Hall notice*

![Kartoffelfest program with a potato wearing a hat](https://fabianokunst.github.io/Teewald-3d/site/img/documentos/en/programa.png)
*Kartoffelfest program*

![School essay: what I saw from my window](https://fabianokunst.github.io/Teewald-3d/site/img/documentos/en/redacao.png)
*School essay*

![Lost-dog poster for Bóris](https://fabianokunst.github.io/Teewald-3d/site/img/documentos/en/cartaz-boris.png)
*Poster on the bridge*

Now I only fish by day. And you ought to do the same.

Home before dark.

![Seu Valdir sitting on a bench in the square](https://fabianokunst.github.io/Teewald-3d/site/img/capturas/valdir.jpg)
*Seu Valdir never puts down his chimarrão*

*It’s happened before*

### Seventy-eight

> In seventy-eight it happened again. I was a young man. Livestock died in three farm districts. Then it stopped, out of nowhere. The town chose to forget.
>
> — Professor Edgar

Those who lived through that year don’t like to talk about it. Seu Valdir drinks his chimarrão alone on a bench in the square and has an old scar on his cheek. If you’re patient, he’ll tell you.

*The stranger*

### You

The protagonist has no name. He came from outside, in a leather jacket, and everyone notices. He decided to stay and hunt whatever walks in the woods.

The townsfolk are scared: they shut their windows and stare at whoever walks by. But each one has seen, heard or lost something. Talk to everyone: that’s where the clues come from.

From here on, the story is yours. We won’t tell you what happens after the first night. Some things in Teewald only make sense up close.

![The protagonist aiming his pistol into the fog](https://fabianokunst.github.io/Teewald-3d/site/img/capturas/mira.jpg)
*9 mm pistol, twelve-round magazine*

### The town would rather forget

Not you. The poster is already up on the bulletin board in the square.

[Play now](https://fabianokunst.github.io/Teewald-3d/?lang=en) Free · in your browser

# The town — Teewald

> The places of Teewald: the Rio Cadeia promenade, Praça 10 de Abril, the parish church, the Kartoffelfest pavilion, the half-timbered houses and the woods. A town made from real maps.

Page: https://fabianokunst.github.io/Teewald-3d/site/en/cidade.html  
Play free in your browser: https://fabianokunst.github.io/Teewald-3d/?lang=en

*The town*

## Shops close at six

Teewald’s streets, river, square and hills come from real maps. You can walk all of it: from the Rio Cadeia promenade to the cemetery behind the parish church, past the square, City Hall and the festival pavilion.

![The promenade along the Rio Cadeia](https://fabianokunst.github.io/Teewald-3d/site/img/capturas/calcadao.jpg)

### Rio Cadeia promenade

Where it all begins.

A path along the river, between the water and the avenue, with a railing, benches, the TEEWALD sign and the Immigrant Monument. There’s a target-shooting stand with cans and bottles to practice your aim. Seu Arno fishes here, but only by day now.

![Praça 10 de Abril at night, with the fountain and the street lamps](https://fabianokunst.github.io/Teewald-3d/site/img/capturas/praca-noite.jpg)

### Praça 10 de Abril

A fountain, hydrangeas, street lamps and a payphone.

Dona Erna’s cuca stall is closed, Seu Valdir never puts down his chimarrão, and the girl at the payphone keeps calling her aunt, who doesn’t answer. On the bulletin board, near the end of the promenade, there’s a new poster.

![Inside the nave of the parish church, with the pews and the altar](https://fabianokunst.github.io/Teewald-3d/site/img/capturas/igreja-dentro.jpg)

### Parish Church

A tower you can see from almost anywhere in town.

A rose window, a portal with archivolts, pointed stained-glass windows and a belfry with louvers. Inside, a blue vault with stars, a pulpit, a confessional, a choir loft with an organ, a sacristy and a staircase up to the bell. Father Bernardo locks everything up before nightfall.

![The empty Kartoffelfest pavilion, with strings of lit bulbs](https://fabianokunst.github.io/Teewald-3d/site/img/capturas/kartoffelfest.jpg)

### Kartoffelfest pavilion

Everything was ready.

Seventy meters of striped canvas over Rua Beno Closs: a half-timbered gateway, a shooting booth, sausages, draft beer, the Kartoffelhaus full of potato sacks, long tables with checkered cloths, a dance floor and the stage for the oompah bands. This year’s festival was canceled. The lights come on all the same.

![The Museum, a half-timbered house](https://fabianokunst.github.io/Teewald-3d/site/img/capturas/enxaimel.jpg)

### Half-timbered houses

Dark beams, white plaster, exposed brick.

A plastered wall, a picket fence, a gate in front of the door and a little path up to the entrance. The Museum keeps what the colonists brought from the Hunsrück. At the shoe factories, the night shift walks home along the promenade. Used to.

![The cemetery in the fog](https://fabianokunst.github.io/Teewald-3d/site/img/capturas/cemiterio.jpg)

### The cemetery

Behind the parish church, old headstones with German names.

Seu Otto has been the caretaker for thirty years. He says little, respects the dead and doesn’t like noise.

![Trees in the fog, at the edge of the woods](https://fabianokunst.github.io/Teewald-3d/site/img/capturas/mato.jpg)

### The woods

It begins where the streets end.

Araucarias, autumn plane trees and a fog that won’t lift. The old folks never went in after sundown. You’ll have to.

*Made from real maps*

### A town that exists

Teewald is inspired by Santa Maria do Herval (Rio Grande do Sul). The street layout, the river, the creeks and the terrain come from open data. The people and the stories are made up.

![Teewald from above, with the river, the streets, the soccer field and the cemetery](https://fabianokunst.github.io/Teewald-3d/site/img/capturas/mapa.jpg)
*From above: the river, the creek, the soccer field and the cemetery*

**600** buildings, give or take, on their real footprints

**SRTM** terrain at its true elevation

**OSM** streets, river, square and soccer field from OpenStreetMap

**24** townsfolk who talk, each in their own spot

### After six, the streets are yours

Yours, and whatever else is out there.

[Play now](https://fabianokunst.github.io/Teewald-3d/?lang=en) Free · in your browser

# Characters — Teewald

> The characters of Teewald: the stranger and the 24 townsfolk who talk, with each one’s portrait, height, clothes and manner, taken from the game’s models.

Page: https://fabianokunst.github.io/Teewald-3d/site/en/personagens.html  
Play free in your browser: https://fabianokunst.github.io/Teewald-3d/?lang=en

*Characters*

## Who’s still out on the street

Twenty-four townsfolk who talk, each with a piece of the story. All of them scared. The portraits were taken from the game’s own models, and the full-body figures are all to the same scale.

*Protagonist*

### You

##### THE STRANGER

The protagonist, no name. Came from outside and stayed to hunt the chupacabra.

- **Age:** 33
- **Height:** 1.75 m
- **Build:** average
- **Face:** Blond, hair combed back, deep-set eyes, straight eyebrows and a thin beard.
- **Body:** Average height and broad shoulders.
- **Clothes:** Brown leather jacket with lapels, gray V-neck sweater, dark shirt, dark pants and boots.
- **Manner:** Serious and quiet. He’s not from town, and everyone notices.

![Face of the Stranger](https://fabianokunst.github.io/Teewald-3d/site/img/personagens/rostos/heroi.jpg) ![The Stranger, full body](https://fabianokunst.github.io/Teewald-3d/site/img/personagens/corpo/heroi.jpg)

*Townsfolk*

### Who you’ll meet

24 townsfolk who talk, scattered around town. The height, build and posture on each card are the ones in the game, and the facial features (wrinkles, dark circles, freckles, stubble, moles, scars) are painted into the texture.

#### Rio Cadeia promenade

##### SEU ARNO

Retired blacksmith; fishes on the Rio Cadeia promenade

- **Age:** 68
- **Height:** 1.70 m
- **Build:** sturdy
- **Face:** Sunburned, with a full gray beard and bushy eyebrows.
- **Body:** Short and stocky, with the thick arms and hands of a man who pounded iron all his life.
- **Clothes:** Red plaid shirt, gray pants, boots and a straw hat. Fishing rod.
- **Manner:** Says little and distrusts everyone. Now he only fishes by day.

![Face of Seu Arno](https://fabianokunst.github.io/Teewald-3d/site/img/personagens/rostos/arno.jpg) ![Seu Arno, full body](https://fabianokunst.github.io/Teewald-3d/site/img/personagens/corpo/arno.jpg)

##### DONA HILDA

Widow on the promenade; looking for her cat, Mimi

- **Age:** 74
- **Height:** 1.55 m
- **Build:** thin, stooped
- **Face:** Deep wrinkles, dark circles and glasses; gray hair under a purple headscarf.
- **Body:** Small and thin, a little stooped.
- **Clothes:** Burgundy sweater, long gray skirt, tights and shoes.
- **Manner:** Distressed, but polite. Keeps calling for Mimi.

![Face of Dona Hilda](https://fabianokunst.github.io/Teewald-3d/site/img/personagens/rostos/hilda.jpg) ![Dona Hilda, full body](https://fabianokunst.github.io/Teewald-3d/site/img/personagens/corpo/hilda.jpg)

##### LUCAS

Looking for his dog, Bóris; lives in the last house before the bridge

- **Age:** 19
- **Height:** 1.81 m
- **Build:** thin
- **Face:** Brown skin, a thin beard and brown eyes.
- **Body:** Tall and thin, walks fast.
- **Clothes:** Blue jacket with a gray collar, dark pants, light sneakers and a red cap.
- **Manner:** Restless; whistles and shouts for Bóris.

![Face of Lucas](https://fabianokunst.github.io/Teewald-3d/site/img/personagens/rostos/lucas.jpg) ![Lucas, full body](https://fabianokunst.github.io/Teewald-3d/site/img/personagens/corpo/lucas.jpg)

##### MARLENE

Reporter for a Porto Alegre newspaper

- **Age:** 31
- **Height:** 1.68 m
- **Build:** average
- **Face:** Light-brown skin, brown eyes and a mole on her cheek; black hair in a ponytail.
- **Body:** Average height, nimble.
- **Clothes:** Mustard jacket, jeans and sneakers. Camera in hand.
- **Manner:** Pushy and curious. Nobody in town wants to talk to her.

![Face of Marlene](https://fabianokunst.github.io/Teewald-3d/site/img/personagens/rostos/marlene.jpg) ![Marlene, full body](https://fabianokunst.github.io/Teewald-3d/site/img/personagens/corpo/marlene.jpg)

##### PROFESSOR EDGAR

Retired history teacher; knows the colonists’ diaries

- **Age:** 79
- **Height:** 1.76 m
- **Build:** thin, stooped
- **Face:** White hair and mustache, light-rimmed glasses, bushy eyebrows and deep wrinkles.
- **Body:** Tall and thin, stooped with age.
- **Clothes:** Worn brown suit, light shirt, blue tie and gray beret. Always carrying a book.
- **Manner:** Speaks slowly, as if in a classroom. Stares at passersby.

![Face of Professor Edgar](https://fabianokunst.github.io/Teewald-3d/site/img/personagens/rostos/edgar.jpg) ![Professor Edgar, full body](https://fabianokunst.github.io/Teewald-3d/site/img/personagens/corpo/edgar.jpg)

##### SEU LAURO

Has been waiting for the bus to Novo Hamburgo since noon

- **Age:** 66
- **Height:** 1.72 m
- **Build:** average
- **Face:** Graying, unshaven, with the dark circles of a man who doesn’t sleep.
- **Body:** Average height, drooping shoulders.
- **Clothes:** Olive-green jacket, khaki pants, boots and a green cap. Suitcase at his side.
- **Manner:** Tired and set on leaving town.

![Face of Seu Lauro](https://fabianokunst.github.io/Teewald-3d/site/img/personagens/rostos/lauro.jpg) ![Seu Lauro, full body](https://fabianokunst.github.io/Teewald-3d/site/img/personagens/corpo/lauro.jpg)

##### KÁTIA

Night-shift worker at the shoe factory

- **Age:** 27
- **Height:** 1.62 m
- **Build:** thin
- **Face:** Brown skin, brown eyes and night-shift dark circles; black hair in a ponytail.
- **Body:** Slim, of medium height.
- **Clothes:** Light-blue shirt, navy pants and shoes. Cloth bag.
- **Manner:** Frightened; keeps looking over her shoulder as she walks.

![Face of Kátia](https://fabianokunst.github.io/Teewald-3d/site/img/personagens/rostos/katia.jpg) ![Kátia, full body](https://fabianokunst.github.io/Teewald-3d/site/img/personagens/corpo/katia.jpg)

##### SEU BRUNO

Owner of the flower shop

- **Age:** 56
- **Height:** 1.77 m
- **Build:** sturdy
- **Face:** Brown hair, mustache, glasses and green eyes.
- **Body:** Heavyset, with the belly of a man past fifty.
- **Clothes:** Green overalls over a light shirt, and boots. Watering can in hand.
- **Manner:** Quiet and watchful; stares at passersby.

![Face of Seu Bruno](https://fabianokunst.github.io/Teewald-3d/site/img/personagens/rostos/bruno.jpg) ![Seu Bruno, full body](https://fabianokunst.github.io/Teewald-3d/site/img/personagens/corpo/bruno.jpg)

#### Praça 10 de Abril

##### SEU VALDIR

Retired gaúcho; drinks chimarrão on a bench in the square

- **Age:** 72
- **Height:** 1.71 m
- **Build:** thin
- **Face:** Weathered skin, gray mustache, bushy eyebrows and an old scar on his cheek.
- **Body:** Lean and wiry despite his age.
- **Clothes:** Black brimmed hat, dark jacket, red shirt and light pants. Mate gourd and thermos.
- **Manner:** A man of few words. He lived through the 1978 events and never forgot.

##### DONA ERNA

*From the poster on the bulletin board in the square*

*What walks in the woods*

### Wanted

Nobody got a good look. Seu Arno saw red eyes on the far bank of the river. Joãozinho, from the 4th grade, swears the thing hops around like a kangaroo and has spikes on its back.

In the game, every creature you see up close gets an entry in LEGENDS OF HERVAL. Here they stay locked. And there’s more than one.

### They’re afraid

You’ve got a 9 mm, a flashlight and the whole night ahead of you.

[Play now](https://fabianokunst.github.io/Teewald-3d/?lang=en) Free · in your browser

---

*A work of fiction: Teewald was born of imagination. The characters, their names, the dialogue and everything that happens in the game are made up, and any resemblance to real persons, living or dead, or to real events is purely coincidental. Santa Maria do Herval (RS) served only as inspiration for the setting: the street layout and street names, the river, the terrain and a few places come from public maps and appear only as scenery. The game does not portray the town, its residents, businesses or institutions, and has no connection whatsoever with the City Hall or any organization in the municipality.*

---

# The game — Teewald

> How to play Teewald: combat, inventory, files, the CLEAN 3D and RETRO PS1 visual styles, weather, keyboard, controller and touch controls, and frequently asked questions.

Page: https://fabianokunst.github.io/Teewald-3d/site/en/jogo.html  
Play free in your browser: https://fabianokunst.github.io/Teewald-3d/?lang=en

*The game*

## How to survive

Third person, an over-the-shoulder camera and scarce ammo. Teewald is old-school survival horror that runs right in your browser.

*Combat*

### With whatever’s at hand

- A three-hit punch combo, always available. Your strike turns on its own toward whoever is closest.
- Stick, iron pipe, shovel, scythe and axe. They hit harder, but wear out and break.
- Rocks and bricks to throw. With a gun in hand, a pistol whip.
- A quick dodge, with a split second of grace to get clear of a lunge.
- A 9 mm pistol to start with. The rest you earn along the way.
- Every legend has its weak spot. Bullets don’t always do it.

Each chapter ends with a rank, from S to C, based on creatures defeated, deaths and time. Three difficulties: easy, normal and hard.

![The protagonist aiming his pistol over the shoulder](https://fabianokunst.github.io/Teewald-3d/site/img/capturas/mira.jpg)
*When you aim, the camera moves to the shoulder*

![Inventory screen with its slots and an item in 3D](https://fabianokunst.github.io/Teewald-3d/site/img/capturas/en/inventario.jpg)
*16-slot inventory*

*Inventory and files*

### Everything that fits in your pockets

Sixteen slots in the style of PS1 survival horror, with the item spinning in 3D. Equip, load, eat, examine. Health comes back with **cuca** (crumb cake) and **marcela tea**, and defeated creatures sometimes drop ammo.

Around town there are newspaper clippings, letters, posters and diary pages, and each one is kept in FILES. The legends you see up close get an entry. And some people need help: a cat and a dog have gone missing.

*Visual style*

### Two ways to see it

Drag the divider. On the left, CLEAN 3D; on the right, RETRO PS1. Both are in OPTIONS, along with the lighting.

![The parish church at nightfall in CLEAN 3D style](https://fabianokunst.github.io/Teewald-3d/site/img/capturas/estilo-limpo.jpg)

![The same view in RETRO PS1 style, at low resolution](https://fabianokunst.github.io/Teewald-3d/site/img/capturas/estilo-ps1.jpg)

#### Clean 3D

Your screen’s native resolution, anti-aliasing and smooth textures. The low-poly models look crisp.

#### Retro PS1

320×240 scaled up without smoothing, dithering and 15-bit color. The way a tube TV showed it.

#### Lighting

ADVANCED, with a low late-afternoon sun, shadows from the sun and the moonlight, and halos around the street lamps. Or CLASSIC, overcast and shadowless.

*Weather and sound*

### The weather turns

Overcast afternoons, dusk, pitch-black nights, predawn fog, rain, drizzle and storms, with the thunder arriving after the flash. At night your flashlight leads the way, the street lamps in the square come on and everything else stays dark.

Every sound in the game is made in code: wind, river, rain on the roof, crickets, crows, lapwings, wood creaking inside the house and the church bell, louder near the tower and muffled between walls. With headphones, you can tell which side a noise is coming from.

![A lightning flash over the town on a stormy night](https://fabianokunst.github.io/Teewald-3d/site/img/capturas/tempestade.jpg)
*First the flash, then the thunder*

*Controls*

### Keyboard, controller or touch

**Keyboard and mouse**

- **Move:** `W` `A` `S` `D` or arrow keys
- **Run:** `Shift`
- **Jump · dodge:** `Space` · `C` or `Ctrl`
- **Camera:** mouse (click the screen to lock it) · `Q` `E` · wheel zooms
- **Talk, read, take, enter:** `F` or `E`
- **Aim · shoot:** right button (hold) · left button
- **Strike:** `V` · left button without a firearm
- **Switch weapon · reload:** `1` to `8` · `R`
- **Eat, drink (heal):** `H`
- **Inventory · files:** `I` or `Tab` · `J`
- **Minimap · pause:** `M` · `Esc` or `P`

**Controller**

- **Move · camera:** left stick · right stick (`R3` recenters)
- **Run:** `B` (hold) or `L3`
- **Jump · dodge:** `A` · `B` (quick tap)
- **Talk, read, take, enter:** `A`
- **Aim · shoot:** `L2` or `LB` · `R2`
- **Strike:** `RB`
- **Switch weapon · reload:** D-pad ◀ ▶ · `X`
- **Eat, drink (heal):** D-pad ▲
- **Inventory:** `Y`
- **Pause and files · minimap:** `Start` · `Select`

**Touch**

- **Move:** drag on the left side of the screen
- **Camera:** drag on the right side (or on SHOOT itself) · double tap recenters · pinch zooms
- **Run · jump · dodge:** RUN, JUMP and DODGE buttons
- **Talk, read, take, enter:** the button appears over the person or object
- **Aim · shoot · strike:** AIM toggles on and off · SHOOT · STRIKE
- **Weapon · reload · heal:** WEAPON · REL · HEAL (shows up when you’re hurt)
- **Inventory · pause:** INV · ❚❚

With a controller or touch there’s aim assist (off, normal or strong) and vibration on shots and strikes. On phones, the on-screen buttons disappear when a Bluetooth controller is in use.

*Where to play*

### Nothing to install

**Platforms:** PC, Phone, Tablet, Controller, Touch.

All you need is an up-to-date browser with WebGL: Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari. On a phone it plays best in landscape, and on Android the game goes full screen when you tap the title screen.

Your progress saves itself in the browser: whenever you move on to a new stage, at checkpoints and every twenty seconds. CONTINUE takes you back to exactly where you left off.

**Languages:** Português, English, Español, Deutsch.

*Questions*

**How much does it cost?**

Nothing. Just open it and play.

**Where is my progress saved?**

In the browser of the device you played on. Clearing the site’s data erases your progress, and another device starts from scratch.

**Can I play with a controller?**

Yes, on PC and phone, with a USB or Bluetooth controller. The menus work with a controller too.

**Is it very scary?**

It’s a horror game: there’s darkness, blood, creatures and jump scares, in the spirit of ’90s survival horror. Play at night, with headphones, if you dare.

**Is the town real?**

Only the map: it is inspired by Santa Maria do Herval (RS), with real streets and terrain. The residents, the names and the stories came from imagination, and any resemblance to real people or events is purely coincidental.

**How many chapters are there?**

Twelve. What happens in each one, the game will tell you.

### Ready for the first night?

Pistol in its holster, a twelve-round magazine and a box of bullets. The rest you’ll find along the way.

[Play now](https://fabianokunst.github.io/Teewald-3d/?lang=en) Free · in your browser

---

*A work of fiction: Teewald was born of imagination. The characters, their names, the dialogue and everything that happens in the game are made up, and any resemblance to real persons, living or dead, or to real events is purely coincidental. Santa Maria do Herval (RS) served only as inspiration for the setting: the street layout and street names, the river, the terrain and a few places come from public maps and appear only as scenery. The game does not portray the town, its residents, businesses or institutions, and has no connection whatsoever with the City Hall or any organization in the municipality.*
